description: Returns ready-to-run code that reports to a push monitor every interval, from Uptime Kuma's own samples, with the monitor's push URL and interval filled in. Use it after creating a push monitor, for the user's cron job or script. The push URL holds the monitor's token, a credential: it reads "***" (and the code will not work) unless includeSecrets is set.

includeSecrets.description: Return credentials in full instead of "***"; they then stay in the transcript. Default: false, or UPTIME_KUMA_INCLUDE_SECRETS.

language.description: One of bash-curl, csharp, docker, go, java, javascript-fetch, php, powershell, python, typescript-fetch (default: bash-curl)

monitorID.description: The push monitor. Find IDs with listMonitors.

name: getPushExample

interval.description: Seconds between pushes, from the monitor

note.description: Where the host in the URL came from

title: Get Push Example
